title: Combinatorial CRISPR-Cas9 Knockout Screen
protocol: Identify genes and gene pairs for testing in the assay.
Design 20 bp gRNA to target each gene, avoiding poly-T sequences and off-target editing.
Purchase pooled oligonucleotide libraries from commercial vendors such as CustomArray (Bothell, WA).
Amplify full-length oligonucleotides with dual gRNA spacers using Kapa HiFi enzyme.
Set up PCR reactions according to the manufacturer’s protocol, using 1 μL of synthesized oligonucleotide template.
Use an annealing temperature of 55 °C and an extension time of 15 s for the PCR reactions.
Repeat ten 50 µL PCR reactions for each library.
Run PCR product on a 2% agarose gel electrophoresis.
Separate the 144 bp amplicon from the gel.
Purify the separated amplicon with the QIAquick gel extraction kit.
Digest gRNA-LGP vector with BsmBI via a reaction at 55°C for 3 hours.
Treat the digested vector with 2 μL of Calf Intestinal Alkaline Phosphatase at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Purify the treated vector with QIAquick PCR Purification Kit.
Assemble the paired gRNAs into the vector using 10 Gibson assembly reactions in parallel.
Incubate dual gRNA inserts and Gibson Assembly Master Mix with water up to 20 μL at 50°C for 1 hour.
Purify the mixture using QIAquick PCR Purification Kit.
Transform purified product into One Shot Stbl3 Chemically Competent E. coli.
Spread a small fraction of cultures on carbenicillin LB plates.
Amplify remaining cultures overnight in 150 ml LB medium.
Extract plasmid DNA from amplified cultures using HiSpeed Plasmid Maxi Kit.
Pick twenty independent clones for Sanger sequencing to estimate library quality.
Digest the Cloning Step 1 library plasmids with BsmBI at 55°C for 3 hours.
Treat linearized plasmids with Calf Intestinal Alkaline Phosphatase at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Gel-purify cut plasmids using 0.6% agarose gel electrophoresis and QIAquick gel extraction.
Digest step 3 inserts with BsmBI at 55°C for 3 hours.
Purify the step 2 insert PCR product.
Mix 0.8 μg of purified PCR product with Buffer 3.1, 5 μL of 10× BSA, 3 μL of BsmBI, and up to 50 μL with H2O.
Incubate the mixture at the appropriate conditions for digestion.

Ligate the step 1 library and step 2 insert digested products using T4 DNA Ligase in a reaction containing 2 μL of 10X T4 DNA Ligase Buffer, 100 ng of each digested product, 1 μL of high concentration T4 DNA Ligase, and up to 20 μL with H2O.
Incubate the ligation reaction overnight at 16°C.
Heat inactivate the reaction at 65°C for 10 minutes.
Transform 4 μL of reaction into 100 μL of ElectroMAX Stbl4 Competent Cells using an Eppendorf Electroporator according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Spread a small fraction (1-10 μL) of cultures on carbenicillin (50 μg/ml) LB plates to calculate the library coverage.
Plate the rest of the cultures on ten 15 cm LB-carbenicillin plates and grow overnight at 37°C for amplification.
Extract plasmid DNA using HiSpeed Plasmid Maxi Kit.
Seed HEK293T cells in 15 cm tissue culture dishes one day before transfection so that they are 70-80% confluent at the time of transfection.
Maintain HEK293T cells in DMEM medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum.
Change to fresh culture media on the day of transfection.
Dilute 36 μL of Lipofectamine 3000 in 1.2 mL OptiMEM for each 15 cm dish.
Separately, dilute 3 µg pMD2.G, 12 µg of pCMV delta R8.2, 9 µg of lentiviral vector and 48 μL of P3000 Reagent in 1.2 mL OptiMEM.
Incubate the diluted components for 5 min at room temperature.
Combine the Lipofectamine 3000 mixture and DNA mixture.
Incubate the combined mixture at room temperature for 30 min.
Add the mixture dropwise to HEK293T cells.
Return HEK293T cells to incubator.
Remove and collect media 48 hours after transfection to harvest virus.
Replace with fresh media.
Remove and collect media again 72 hours after transfection.
Combine 48 and 72 hr harvests.
Further concentrate virus using Centricon Plus-20 centrifugal ultrafilters with a cutoff of 100,000 NMWL to a final volume of 450 µL.
Aliquot and freeze the concentrated virus at -80°C.
Plate sufficient cells on day -1 so that by day 1 there will be three times the desired minimum coverage.
Ensure cells are approximately 50%-60% confluent on day 1.
Transduce cells with gRNA library virus at an MOI of 0.3 or lower on day 0.
Change media to remove virus on day 1.
Passage cells if they are greater than 85% confluent, otherwise leave until day 3.
Count and passage cells on day 3.
Freeze down enough cells to account for the minimum desired coverage.
Re-plate enough cells to account for the minimum desired coverage.
Start puromycin selection at a predetermined selection dose.
Passage cells every 2-4 days from days 4 to 28 as needed.
At each passage, re-plate enough cells to account for the minimum desired coverage and freeze the rest.
Extract DNA from cells harvested at 3, 14, 21, and 28-day time points using the Blood and Cell Culture DNA Mini Kit according to manufacturer protocols.
Quantitate DNA extracted to ensure adequate coverage before starting library preparation.
Perform PCR 1 in 10 separate 50 μL reactions using 2 μg input genomic DNA per reaction with Kapa Hifi enzyme, NGS_dual-gRNA_SP_Lib_F and NGS_dual-gRNA_SP_Lib_R primers.
Run thermocycling at 95°C for 30 s, followed by 21-26 cycles of (98°C for 15 s, 55°C for 15 s, 72°C for 45 s), and 72°C for 5 min.
Pool amplicons of 600 bp from 10 reactions per sample.
Size-select and purify pooled amplicons with Agencourt AMPure XP beads at a ratio of 0.8.
Further purify the product with QIAquick PCR Purification.
Perform PCR 2 in 4 separate 50 μL reactions using 5 ng first-step PCR product per reaction, using Next® Multiplex Oligos for Illumina to attach Illumina adaptors and indexes.
Run thermocycling at 95°C for 30 s, followed by 7-8 cycles of (98°C for 15 s, 72°C for 45 s), and 72°C for 5 min.
Pool amplicons from the four reactions.
Size-select and purify the pooled amplicons twice using Agencourt AMPure XP beads at an 0.8 ratio.
Quantify the purified PCR library using real-time PCR with the Illumina Library Quantification kit (Kapa Biosystems).
Trim FASTQ files of scaffold sequence using cutadapt, discarding trimmed reads shorter than 19 or longer than 21 bps.
Truncate remaining reads to 19 bases from the appropriate end and reverse-complement reads from the reverse strand.
Check both reads in a pair for sequence matches against gRNA sequences used in the library, allowing one mismatch anywhere in a read.
Aggregate read pairs that matched to a known construct to compute the total counts for each construct in the relevant sample.
Fit linear regression to each gRNA to determine fitness.
Remove data points below the minimum threshold of raw sequencing reads.
Rank gRNAs for each gene by absolute fitness effect.
Assign weights to ranked gRNAs.
Combine weighted values for the 3 gRNAs per gene to determine fitness effect for each gene.
Determine genetic interactions from measured fitness of double gRNA constructs.
Calculate expected double knockout fitness using single gene fitness effects (f_c = f_p + f_p' + π_pp').
Identify interactions (π_pp') from the difference between observed and expected double knockout fitness.
